status: experimental profile/conformance surface; no new cryptographic primitive
purpose: Bind exact cryptographic mechanisms, purposes, key lifecycle, migration rules, and non-authority semantics into replaceable versioned profiles.

current_compatible_profiles.use: authenticated encryption for local protected state
service, node, artifact, and receipt signing where the current implementation already uses Ed25519

primitives.digest_binding: SHA-256 where an external digest binding is required by the surrounding format

primitives.peer_identity: DNS and SPIFFE-style URI binding plus active-leaf pinning

profile_requirements: independent test vectors or implementation evidence where applicable
key_separation_rules: signing keys are not data-encryption keys
transport identity keys are not recipient-encryption keys
root or recovery keys are not used for ordinary service traffic
one compromised key purpose must not automatically compromise unrelated purposes
key identifiers and digests may travel farther than secret key material
migration_rule: Profiles are replaceable. A stronger or newer profile is introduced through explicit migration, dual-read/dual-verify or staged re-encryption where appropriate, evidence capture, rollback planning, and retirement of the old profile. Profile names such as latest are never authoritative.
nonclaims: This profile does not claim that every listed primitive is appropriate for every jurisdiction, threat model, or future cryptographic horizon.
This profile does not authorize effects.
This profile does not make cryptographic integrity equivalent to truth, consent, legal validity, or identity.
Post-quantum migration is a separate reviewable programme and is not claimed implemented here.
